recap.text: Donut likes the beige boonie hat for being extra floppy, though it clashes with her fit, and Carl insists it is a boonie hat, not a bucket hat. It adds a Targeting skill and extends the range of all her spells. Mordecai tells her to set a ten-and-a-half-hour timer and put it first on the new tiara's red charge pillow, where it clicks into place.

beats.headline: What snipers wear
beats.text: Donut likes the hat, at least, even if she already has a few from the babababoons on the fourth floor. It is beige, which she does not care for, but extra floppy, which she does, though it clashes with her fit. They are boonie hats, Carl says, not bucket hats: what snipers wear. It adds a Targeting skill to zoom in and examine mobs from afar, like the gnomish farseerer but less awkward, and increases the range of all her spells. With the suit as well, she could snipe enemies from well over a mile.
beats.gist: The beige boonie hat gives Donut a Targeting skill and longer spell range.

beats.headline: First on the pillow
beats.text: The first thing to put on the new tiara's charge pillow, Mordecai says, is the hat she just got with the targeting ability. And set a timer for ten and a half hours to be safe, because the pillows give no notice when a transfer is done, a bug for a very long time. Donut sets her new boonie hat on the red pillow, and it clicks into place.
beats.gist: Mordecai says Donut's new boonie hat goes on the tiara's charge pillow first, with a ten-and-a-half-hour timer.

beats.headline: In the crown
beats.text: The virtual sun rises over an army of tens of thousands, glinting like a blade. Donut studies the orc prince across the field with her new Targeting skill, which has just been added to her crown. She yelps: Carl, that's not Prince Stalwart. Carl looks again from afar. The orc is bigger than he first thought.
beats.gist: Donut's Targeting skill shows the orc prince is not Prince Stalwart, and Carl sees it is bigger.
